scope: Proposition 5.1 (Product decomposition) of the manuscript “Uniform log Iitaka fibrations and bounded moduli denominators” (preprints/Uniform-log-Iitaka-fibrations-and-bounded-moduli-denominators-October-4-2026/uniform-log-iitaka.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fee79cbeaa3ae4f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (V, B) be a projective klt pair over C with B ≥ 0, KV rational Cartier, and KV +B ∼Q 0. There is a finite quasi-étale cover π : P → V and a decomposition (P, π∗ B) ≃ (F, H) × A × Y j Yj × Y k Zk, where (F, H) is a rationally connected klt log Calabi–Yau pair, A is an abelian variety, and the Yj and Zk are respectively irreducible Calabi–Yau and irreducible holomorphic symplectic varieties in the singular Beauville–Bogomolov decomposition. All factors are Q-Gorenstein. Point factors are omitted, and the boundary is pulled back entirely from F.
